I replied to Pree in your DM. I said I'll keep the possible 165-seat change for Quarrendon Freight Lines' Amendment No. 1 private, and that I'll help once it's confirmed.

- **Not stored anywhere:** I didn't put the 165 figure into GBrain, any channel or any other conversation. GBrain is shared, so saving it there would have spread it further.
- **Not raised with Pree:** I checked GBrain first and found a #north-team chat from Aug 2025. In it, Dana Okafor says Amendment No. 1 took Quarrendon to 185 seats; Dana first wrote 180, then corrected it. Pree is on the Central team, and I didn't confirm she's in #north-team, so I didn't mention this to her.

GBrain is set up for keyword search only, so that lookup may not have found everything on Quarrendon.
